label: The CLI cross-path harness skill-advisor-cli-parity.vitest.ts compares exactly one dimension, top-1 skillId, over 9 gold-anchored prompts on both paths (Python CLI with --force-local --threshold 0.8 --uncertainty 0.35; shim advisor_recommend with topK:1), failing on any mismatch; it skips when python3 is missing, and its title claims ten prompts while the array holds nine.

local-native-divergence-ratchet.vitest.ts compares strict top-1 with a shared none abstention sentinel over a 217-prompt union corpus (195 labeled + 22 harder) and ratchets against a 73-entry approved-divergence ledger (68 labeled / 5 harder; id/corpus/promptHash/gold/localTop/nativeTop/reason/approvedAt); its five rules fail on new unapproved divergence, resolved entries, recorded-field drift, duplicate ids and orphan ids, and python3 absence fails loudly.

python-ts-parity.vitest.ts is the aggregate-count model: pinned no-graph regime, 195-row corpus, exact assertions pythonCorrect=107, tsAlsoCorrect=100, regressions exact-equal to the 8 reviewed ids, tsAbstainsOnPythonCorrect=0, tsCorrect>=95, tsUnknown<=13, goldNoneFalseFire<=10, holdoutCorrect>=17; no confidence value or rank below first is compared.

No .github/workflows file references local-native-divergence, python-ts-parity, skill-advisor-cli-parity or holdout-independent; the advisor gates CI runs are golden prompts (routing-registry-drift.yml:256), scorer-eval-baseline-ratchet (:268), admission --warn-only (:180) and the stress suite (skill-advisor-stress.yml:66), whose config excludes tests/**; the ratchet's self-description as a CI gate (:31-33) is therefore contradicted by the wiring.

Recommendation: a cross-path parity check should compare top-1 skill plus abstention (normalized none/null), not raw confidence values or ranks >= 2, because every existing harness compares only top-1, no cross-implementation score calibration exists, abstention semantics differ by construction (Python thresholds vs TS lane ranking), and lower-rank order is unstable at the 0.82 floors.

Recommendation: reuse the ratchet's failure contract for a cross-path gate - fail on any new unapproved divergence, any resolved ledger entry, any recorded-field drift, any malformed ledger, and fail loudly when python3 is unavailable; a gold-anchored CLI smoke can coexist but is not the gate.
